instruction: The italic formatting alone isn't making technical terms stand out enough in this document. Please add underline formatting to all italicized words so they have both italic and underline styles applied.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding underline formatting to all italicized text. Verified document has 21 italic runs. The evaluator checks content preservation and validates all italic text also has underline formatting.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: (1) finds all italic text, (2) checks that all italic text also has underline formatting, (3) verifies content preservation.

Metric function properly handles expected parameter: checks if expected is dict (lines 28-29), extracts reference_file URL (line 29), downloads file using requests (lines 36-38), and saves to temp file (lines 41-43).
Logic flow is correct: opens both documents, compares paragraph text for content preservation (lines 63-84), then iterates through all runs checking italic runs have underline (lines 86-100).
Edge cases handled properly: checks for None underline value explicitly (line 92: 'if run.font.underline is None or not run.font.underline').
Proper cleanup: temp file is cleaned up in all code paths (lines 56-60, 69-73, 78-83, 95-99, 103-107).
Complete coverage: verifies ALL italic runs have underline, not just some. Returns 0.0 if any italic text lacks underline, 1.0 only if all pass.
